label: GOD_4 exists, from the owner's definitional argument (P1 and P2, analyst formulation)
description: Valid transcription (instantiation) of the owner-specified definitional argument: P1 (the existing omnibenevolent God has been defined) and the weak P2 (whatever is defined is satisfied) give GodExists over the frame's beings, the objects satisfying its existence predicate. The proof applies P2 to P1's description and drops the omnibenevolence conjunct. It establishes neither premise and gives no warrant: the unrestricted P2 is refuted premise-free and the weak P2 fails under the contrary sole-God definition (retorsion result in this batch).
